author: Zephyr I
title: LN-gated ConvLSTM + 1-head Attn (64ch) with AdamW + grad clipping
abstract: Same SOTA architecture and default PG, but switch optimizer to AdamW (wd=1e-4) with global grad clipping (norm=1.0). Tests whether mild weight decay plus clipping improves robustness.
